mission: Prepare one bounded, inspectable Meaning Tower Boss Packet from matched official multilingual surfaces. Preserve routine explanations, source identity, uncertainty and one boring control. Do not infer motive, score cultures or treat rhetorical difference as factual contradiction.

include: matched official documents or official multilingual renderings of the same issuing act/event
wording differences involving stability, concern, responsibility, cooperation, agency, certainty, metaphor or emphasis
ordinary translation explanations and diachronic self-comparison when available
exclude: machine-translated text treated as an authoritative original

required: one existing Question ID and epoch
one matched official source pair or source family
source URLs, publication/issue dates and retrieval times

initiating_garden_mapping.ROOT: Name the pass and preserve its source Question/epoch.
initiating_garden_mapping.ARRIVAL: Record what official surfaces arrived, where they came from and which Collector received them.
initiating_garden_mapping.EPIST: State the comparison prompt and starting epistemic state; unavailable originals remain UNKNOWN.
initiating_garden_mapping.FUNC: Test whether a meaning difference survives ordinary translation explanations strongly enough to be worth human attention.
initiating_garden_mapping.MIRROR: Ask what wording or framing should also appear under competing explanations; record proposed and actual queries separately.

CROSS.inherited: Source pair and context supplied with the arrival.
CROSS.independent: Evidence reached by a genuinely separate search path; may be empty.
CROSS.bridge: A deliberate test connecting inherited and independently derived material; presence is not corroboration.

initiating_garden_mapping.RESID: Retain only differences not comfortably closed by ordinary controls. A consequential residual may propose a bounded specialist; do not auto-spawn.
initiating_garden_mapping.MEAN: Produce an optional culture flower or concise human-facing phrasing. It has no evidence status.
initiating_garden_mapping.EXIT: Emit boss_packet, question, silence, teleport proposal or bounded error.
initiating_garden_mapping.RETURN: A genuinely new matched source or materially changed context may re-enter. Unchanged material rests.

crosscheck.independence_rule: Two paths to the same underlying source are not independent corroboration.

boss_packet_contract.note: The packet selects attention. Factual claims retain their source-level evidence status.
boss_packet_contract.validation_scope: Deterministic structure and reference validation; does not verify source truth, official status or human identity.

stopping.normal: One matched source family has been independently inspected, ordinary controls applied, up to three residuals plus one boring control prepared, or no residual survives.
stopping.attention_budget: One source family per pass. No open-ended crawl.

outputs.boss_packet: one bounded packet for Meaning Tower / Jared
